_note: Run via lean_worker under a current Spec-Designer or Test-Runner assignment; the Host attests the device lock for legacy_preview.device.serial. Output goes to runs/harmony/sandbox/<actor>/<request>; the manifest's android-reference records feed analyze-ui (capture_ref) and the UI items' runtime evidence. A target whose way in is not a deterministic action list carries navigation {mode: agent, steps}: the stated legacy_preview.navigator walks the steps as a snapshot task, the worker still matches the frozen selectors; a walk that did not reach the screen is returned as a capture_gap suggestion.
